name: What indoor air quality practices are used in green homes?

mainEntity.name: What indoor air quality practices are used in green homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Low-VOC paints/finishes, MERV 13+ filtration, exhaust fans in kitchens/baths, radon mitigation, and operable windows for ventilation reduce pollutants and allergens. wbdg+1
